newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telesp still a Fator buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telesp still a Fator buy.

text.p: Fator Securities on Thursday said it had reiterated its buy rating on Telesp, a unit of Brazilian federally-owned telecommunications firm Telebras serving Sao Paulo state.

-- "We are maintaining our buy recommendation for Telesp due to recent progress on the privatization front and confirmation of our forecasts," said analysts Sidney Chameh and Sergio Missima in a report.
-- said Telesp's first-half net income was 448 million reais, slightly lower than Fator's estimates of 464 million reais.
-- also said Fator's target price for the end of 1997 is 405.50 reais, representing an upside potential of 20 percent over the current price.
-- Telesp preferred was up 2.07 percent at 345 reais in mid-afternoon trade on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
